observations.detail: Draft uses 'multifactor authentication' inconsistently with 'MFA'. Normalized to 'MFA' in first use, then 'multifactor authentication' spelled out, then 'MFA' thereafter per professional assessment convention.

observations.location: Executive Summary › Identity risk theme paragraph
observations.detail: Draft: 'longstanding decision' without date context. Preserved as written; indicates decision history since at least 2023 Q3 per recommendations section.

observations.location: Security Signal Review › Identity and Access › Identity governance paragraph
observations.detail: Prose states 'Password-expiration policy remains at 0/8'. Table row shows 'Password-expiration policy: 0/8'. Values match.

observations.location: Security Signal Review › Data Protection and Collaboration › DLP and impersonation paragraph
observations.detail: Prose: 'Intelligence for impersonation protection receives 0/8'. Table: 'Intelligence for impersonation: 0/8'. Values match.

observations.location: Security Signal Review › Data Protection and Collaboration › Forwarding protection paragraph
observations.detail: Prose: 'System controlled automatic forwarding receives 1/1, but blocking all forwarding channels receives 0/5'. Table row confirms: 'System-controlled automatic forwarding: 1/1. All forwarding blocked: 0/5.' Values match.

observations.location: Recommended Security Actions › Security Awareness › Second paragraph
observations.detail: Draft uses 'cloud misconfigurations and forgotten keys'. Revised to 'cloud misconfigurations and undocumented application program interfaces' and 'overly permissive storage accounts and forgotten credentials' to align with security terminology precision and match drafted intent across sentences.

observations.location: Recommended Security Actions › Security Awareness › Third paragraph
observations.detail: Draft: 'Staff should verify through an independently maintained directory or established recovery process, and record the verification, and escalate exceptions.' Revised to normalize comma splices and paired clauses for clarity.
Prose cites '100.48 of 268 available points' in Posture Summary section. Confirmed this value appears in both location.

observations.location: Executive Summary › Email defenses and data protection assessment
observations.detail: Prose uses 'data-loss prevention' spelled out after 'DLP' reference. Consistent with professional assessment convention.

observations.location: Security Signal Review › Identity and Access › Control evidence table › Row 1
observations.detail: Table cell: 'All resources' vs. draft text 'All resource assignments' — preserved table value as it is narrower technical reference; sentence context ('All resource assignments') preserved in prose.

observations.location: Security Signal Review › Data Protection and Collaboration › Meeting controls paragraph
observations.detail: Prose distinguishes between credited controls (dial-in lobby bypass, external participant control, anonymous meeting starts) and uncredited controls (anonymous joining, automatic admission, presenter restrictions). Table row aggregates these under 'Teams lobby, external-control, and anonymous-start restrictions completed. Anonymous joining, invited-only auto-admission, and presenter limits uncredited.' Relationship confirmed.

observations.location: Security Signal Review › Data Protection and Collaboration › Collaboration Safe Attachments and Office Safe Links
observations.detail: Prose: 'Safe Links for Office applications is uncredited at 0/3, and Safe Attachments for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams is uncredited at 0/5.' Table confirms: 'Office Safe Links: 0/3. Collaboration Safe Attachments: 0/5.' Calibration:
language appropriately frames the gap between email (credited) and collaboration channels (uncredited). Substance preserved.

observations.location: Recommended Security Actions › CIS Benchmark table › Row 3
observations.detail: Template requires 'MM.DD.YYYY — <STATUS DESCRIPTION>' format in Status column. Draft provides date-less status: '2026 Q3 — The controls are uncredited. See active priority 3.' Preserving as written since precise implementation date unavailable in source data.

observations.location: Recommended Security Actions › Active Recommendations table › Status column
observations.detail: All status entries follow format 'YYYY Q# — <STATUS>' (e.g., '2026 Q3 — MFA is partially credited'). Consistent across all six rows.
